priorityList: Use Roll the Bones on cooldown unless you are already in Stage 2 or higher.
Use Keep It Rolling when you are in Stage 2 or higher (hold for Stage 3 or 4 if next Roll the Bones is buffed by Loaded Dice).
Use Adrenaline Rush on cooldown at low Combo Points.
Use Blade Rush on cooldown as if it were a regular builder.
Cast Between the Eyes on cooldown with 6+ Combo Points.
Use Killing Spree on cooldown at 6+ Combo Points.
Cast Dispatch as your main finisher with 6+ Combo Points if it is buffed by Coup de Grace.
Cast Dispatch as your main finisher with 6+ Combo Points.
Cast Pistol Shot if you have 6 stacks of Opportunity; if you have 3 stacks, use it at 1-3 Combo Points only.
Cast Sinister Strike to generate Combo Points.
Cast Roll the Bones on cooldown if at stage 1 or less.
Cast Keep It Rolling if you have a stage 2 or higher Roll the Bones active.
Cast Between the Eyes on cooldown.
Manage combo points efficiently and avoid overcapping.
